task.title: Fail tasks through an explicit workflow-phase turn
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/757 with a phase-assisted failure that separates provider Attempt evidence from the exact caller-owned terminal diagnostic.
acceptance_criteria: Validate active association, fresh Attempt identity, writable session, and phase bindings before provider work.
Persist a valid response as assistant content and Attempt evidence before failure.
Fail with the exact prevalidated caller diagnostic rather than model content.
Preserve ordered prefixes under provider failure and terminal races without mutating workflow lifecycle.

attempts.diagnostic: The focused workflow-phase failure tests failed because fail_workflow_phase_task_turn did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added exact-skill, caller-diagnostic, invalid-preflight, provider-failure, and terminal-race coverage.

attempts.diagnostic: The established task runtime already separated provider Attempt text from validated terminal failure detail.
attempts.patch: Resolved the selected phase before effects, atomically persisted the response as Attempt evidence, then applied the retained TaskFailure.

attempts.summary: Converted a review maintainability finding into bounded follow-up.
attempts.diagnostic: Substantive review observed a fourth copy of the authority-sensitive workflow-phase task preflight, but changing all sibling paths inside the feature would widen scope.
attempts.patch: Preserved the verified failure slice and opened issue 759 for one behavior-preserving shared-preflight refactor.

outcome.summary: A selected phase can produce final Attempt evidence before caller-requested task failure, while the exact terminal diagnostic and all workflow lifecycle authority remain outside model control.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-kernel --test workflow_phase_runtime

lessons: Model-produced explanation is execution evidence, not caller-owned terminal truth.
Ordered durable prefixes make terminal races observable without pretending cross-stream rollback exists.
Substantive review found duplicated authority-sensitive workflow-phase task preflight; the failure slice stayed bounded and issue 759 tracked the shared-preflight refactor.
